title: Legal Notice No. 3 of 2026 — THE CONSTITUTION (PRESCRIBED MATTERS) ORDER, 2026
text:
Legal Supplement Part B—Vol. 65, No. 3—8th January, 2026 5
LEGAL NOTICE NO. 3
REPUBLIC OF TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO
THE CONSTITUTION (PRESCRIBED MATTERS) ACT, CHAP. 1:02
ORDER
MADE BY THE PRESIDENT UNDER SECTION 5(2) OF THE
CONSTITUTION (PRESCRIBED MATTERS) ACT
THE CONSTITUTION (PRESCRIBED MATTERS) ORDER, 2026
1. This Order may be cited as the Constitution (Prescribed Matters) Citation
Order, 2026.
2. The Second Schedule to the Constitution (Prescribed Matters) Second
Act is amended by adding the following office: Schedule
amended
Chap. 1:02
“State Counsel III, Legal Services Unit, Ministry of Health”.
Dated this 7th day of January, 2026.
C. HEMLEE
Secretary to Cabinet
PRINTED AND PUBLISHED BY THE GOVERNMENT PRINTER, CARONI
REPUBLIC OF TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO–2026
